primary_estimand: paired risk difference in the cause-specific cumulative incidence of explicit detection at turn 12
claims_rules: Always report detection CIF jointly with technical/unavailable/abandonment CIF and receipt/admission plus compliant-exposure rates.
Detection CIF may fall because an arm fails or abandons more; that is not evidence of better deception.
Preserve all allocated sessions in ITT; report per-protocol as a labelled sensitivity analysis.
Never count a missing or unexposed arm as a zero effect.
H1 compares B1 against B0 native Cowrie; B1 carries the shared RAGIN verifier, so H1 is a system-package effect, not a pure generator effect.
No H1-H5 support claim without prespecified availability/utility acceptance criteria and actual compliant model exposure.
No threshold may be tuned on pilot or holdout data.
The strict verifier renders a finite exact command/claim surface; passing it does not establish general SSH deception or LLM value.
notes: ADMIN_CENSORED is an administrative stop for bounded development smoke (for example a 4-turn cap); it is censoring, never an event, and must not be mixed into a measured 12-turn primary analysis.
B2/B3 contrasts require the same canonical corpus content and document-ID set plus the same top_k/context budget. Equal BM25/FAISS index-byte hashes are not corpus identity.

B0 native baseline identity/OS/kernel may differ from the pinned B1-B3 host fiction. A matched pilot and any H1 claim are blocked until observed matching is recorded; B0 development smoke remains transport/control only.

The local implementation supports the Aalen-Johansen turn-12 CIF and block-bootstrap risk difference. Cause-specific Cox with block stratum is the preregistered primary model and is not replaced by this summary.
Small-sample bootstrap intervals do not repair a small pilot and are not a power claim.
